title: Animal life cycle cards: cat, chicken, frog, butterfly
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: Changes of materials and animals including humans
source: Seeded from science/y5 lesson 25 (Animal life cycle cards: cat, chicken, frog, butterfly (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 25: Life stages of humans and animals. To understand the main stages in the life of humans and other animals

cards:
life stage
a part of life, like baby or
adult

life cycle
the stages an animal goes
through from birth

adolescent
a young person between child
and adult
blocks.task: use them to test yourself or a partner.

questions.q: Put in order: adult, baby, elderly, child, adolescent.
questions.model: Start at the beginning: a baby. Then a child. Between child and adult: adolescent. Then adult. Last: elderly.

questions.q: Name one need a baby has that an adult does not.
questions.a: For example: being fed, carried, changed

questions.q: Does a chicken have a mammal or a bird life cycle?
questions.a: Bird: it hatches from an egg

questions.q: Make a life stage timeline for a human on the sheet: five stages with one thing each stage can do or needs.
questions.a: Baby: needs feeding; child: learns to read; adolescent: studies, more responsibility; adult: works, cares for family; elderly: needs help, shares wisdom
questions.model: Teacher fills in 'Baby: needs to be fed and carried.'

questions.q: Draw the life cycle of a frog or butterfly and compare it with a human.
questions.a: Frog: egg, tadpole, froglet, frog; butterfly: egg, caterpillar, chrysalis, butterfly. These change shape (metamorphosis); humans do not.

questions.q: Why do human babies need care for so much longer than a foal?
questions.a: Humans have a big brain to grow and much to learn; a foal can walk within hours.

questions.q: Big question: how are a baby's needs different from yours?
questions.a: A baby needs care for everything; I can do much for myself.
